title: [CoreTweaker127][CrazyMod]Unlimited use无限使用
description: 无限这个附魔太没有存在感了，这个模组完美解决了这个问题（让所有物品可以附魔无限并无限使用）快来试试吧！The Infinity enchantment feels too insignificant, and this mod perfectly solves this problem (allowing all items to be enchanted with Infinity and used infinitely). Come and give it a try!
body:
这里推荐一个非常强力的整合包，可以大幅提升帧率和内存利用效率，推荐大家去试试Here's a super powerful pack I recommend—it can greatly boost frame rates and memory efficiency. You should definitely give it a try.：https://modrinth.com/modpack/fps--optimization

模组拥有完全不同的玩法机制与创意方向。无论你选择哪一个版本，都能体验到独特的游戏风格。本模组对 Minecraft 本体的稳定性影响极小，不会修改核心系统，适合在各种环境中轻量使用。 反馈与建议 如果你在游玩过程中产生了新的想法、创意或改进建议，欢迎前往 GitHub 提交 Issue 或反馈意见。你的建议将直接影响未来版本的设计方向，帮助模组持续成长。 版本说明：v2.0.0
允许对任意物品进行无限附魔，附魔后可以进行无限使用，突破传统附魔系统的限制，适合喜欢让物品耐久更多,无限使用机制和喜欢创造性玩法的玩家。 注意：在进行世界记录挑战或速通时一定不要使用此模组，以免被封号
The mod features completely different gameplay mechanics and creative directions. No matter which version you choose, you can experience a unique gaming style. This mod has minimal impact on Minecraft's core stability and does not modify the core system, making it suitable for lightweight use in various environments.  Feedback and Suggestions If you come up with new ideas, creativity, or improvement suggestions while playing, you are welcome to submit an Issue or feedback on GitHub. Your suggestions will directly influence the design direction of future versions and help the mod continue to grow. Version Notes: v2.0.0 Allows unlimited enchantments on any item. After enchanting, items can be used indefinitely, breaking the limitations of the traditional enchantment system. It is suitable for players who like longer item durability, infinite-use mechanics, and creative gameplay. Note: Do not use this mod during world record challenges or speedruns to avoid account suspension.
